stem: A student in a foreign language program learns 15 new words each week. Which graph best represents the relationship between x, the number of weeks the student has been in the program and y, the total number of new words the student has learned?

options.label: F

options.text: Graph labeled H with a line passing through (0,0) and (9,90)
